messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: RedHat build
parts:
My guess is that falling back to Linux is good enough, because there
you have the most variation and also the most use of custom kernels.
More likely we should probably add more cases. For example, the old
Sun hardware on cunix.cc.columbia.edu yields

$ uname -a
SunOS banana 5.9 Generic_122300-59 sun4u sparc SUNW,Sun-Fire-V240
Solaris

Ben
